title: EcoFlow Smart Home Panel v1 — get_quota_all field descriptions
source: EcoFlow Smart Home Panel ModuleType / GetAllQuotaResponse documentation
scope: Smart Home Panel (SP10); not generic EcoFlow products
provenance: Existing Home Assistant ha_diag__get_ecoflow_field_guide, derived from SHP v1 ModuleType / GetAllQuotaResponse documentation; descriptive metadata only, no production payloads.
semantic_guards: Path pattern [] matches each indexed array member.
Most device fields correspond to response.data keys, which are often literal dotted keys; parser must handle both literal dotted keys and nested objects.
The local _cached_at and _has_loadCmdChCtrlInfos fields originate in the existing cache layer and are NOT raw EcoFlow quota data.
Inferred/unknown notes do not establish unit, scaling, enum or type correctness. Do not guess or silently normalize.
The seed covers 81 documented patterns but is not the full set of raw scalar quota leaves; unknown fields must get disabled-by-default entities with truthful fallback descriptions.
A disabled entity must not generate history or a shadow raw JSON archive.

fields.meaning_en: Device operating time, documented in minutes. Observed magnitudes cast doubt on scaling; no conversion is applied.

fields.meaning_en: Reported maximum capacity of the backup system. Unit and scaling are not established.

fields.meaning_en: Documented backup state of charge in percent. Only values from 0 to 100 are valid; larger values remain unknown without guessing a scale.

fields.meaning_de: Array der Kanalsteuerinformationen für die Lastkanäle
fields.notes: Positionen 0..9 entsprechen den Lastkanälen; powCh enthält im Beispiel identische Werte und darf nicht als Index verwendet werden.
fields.meaning_en: Load control array. Positions 0 through 9 correspond to circuits 1 through 10 in the working reference; powCh must not be used as an index.

fields.notes: Nicht aus powCh allein den tatsächlichen Kanal ableiten.
fields.meaning_en: Protocol channel number. Do not derive the actual circuit solely from powCh; array position supplies the tested mapping.
Selected supply of the load circuit: 0 grid, 1 battery, 2 off according to the manufacturer. Other codes are unknown.

fields.meaning_de: Ob der Kanal automatisch oder manuell gesteuert wird
fields.meaning_en: Whether the load circuit is controlled automatically (0) or manually (1).

fields.meaning_de: Priorität des Lastkanals bei der Notstromverwaltung
fields.meaning_en: Priority of the load circuit for emergency power management. Priority ordering is not further interpreted.

fields.meaning_de: Array mit Steuerinformationen für die Backup-Kanäle
fields.notes: Dokumentierte Backup-Kanäle 10–11; powCh im Beispiel nicht eindeutig.
fields.meaning_en: Backup control array. Protocol channels are 10 and 11; displayed entry numbers follow array order, without claiming physical battery assignment.
Backup supply status. The manufacturer calls code 2 off, but the working charge helper reads it as charging. Exposed as a raw code until this conflict is resolved.
fields.implementation_notes_de: Hersteller: 2=Aus; der funktionierende Lade-Helper wertet 2 als Laden. Wegen dieses Widerspruchs wird nur der Rohcode angezeigt, ohne Schaltzustand zu behaupten.

fields.meaning_en: Automatic (0) or manual (1) control of the backup entry.

fields.notes: Dokumentierte Stufen 6/13/16/20/30. Aktueller Beispielcache zeigt 12 Einträge mit diesen zulässigen Werten: vermutlich 10 Last- plus 2 Backup-Kanäle. Einheit A ist naheliegend, aber in diesem Text nicht explizit bestätigt.
fields.meaning_en: Configured current level per array entry. Documentation lists 6/13/16/20/30, but does not explicitly specify amperes. Entries after the ten load channels are not conclusively assigned.

fields.meaning_de: Konfigurierte Netzspannung, laut Dokumentation Wertebereich 100 bis 250

fields.meaning_en: Configured nominal frequency (50 or 60 Hz), not a live frequency measurement.
fields.implementation_notes_de: Konfigurierte Nennfrequenz, kein aktueller Frequenzmesswert.
